yamadashy/repomix: Command-line tool that packs a whole code repository into one AI-friendly file you can paste into Claude, ChatGPT or other LLMs.
srbhr/Resume-Matcher: Free, self-hosted resume builder that uses AI to tailor your resume and cover letter to each job description, with ATS checks and PDF export.
NVIDIA/SkillSpector: NVIDIA's security scanner for AI agent skills: checks a skill for prompt injection, data theft and other risks before you install it.
deezer/spleeter: Deezer's music source separation tool with pretrained models that split songs into vocals, drums, bass, piano and other stems.
eyaltoledano/claude-task-master: AI task manager for coding with Cursor, Claude Code and other editors: turns a product spec into a task list your AI works through.
vercel/ai: Vercel's TypeScript toolkit for building AI apps and agents with one API across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other model providers.
dmlc/xgboost: Fast, widely used gradient boosting library for tabular data that runs on one machine or scales across Spark, Dask and Kubernetes.
humanlayer/12-factor-agents: Free guide of 12 principles for building reliable LLM agents, in the spirit of the classic 12 Factor App, from owning prompts to stateless design.
a2aproject/A2A: Open protocol that lets AI agents built on different frameworks discover each other and work together, with SDKs for Python, JS, Go, Java, .NET and Rust.
activepieces/activepieces: Open-source Zapier alternative for building AI automations with a no-code builder, 200+ app integrations that also work as MCP servers.
vercel-labs/agent-desktop: Computer-use tool for AI agents that reads and operates desktop apps on macOS, Windows and Linux through the accessibility tree, without screenshots.
zai-org/Open-AutoGLM: Phone agent framework from Z.ai that looks at an Android or HarmonyOS screen and taps through apps to finish tasks you describe in plain language.
WZMIAOMIAO/deep-learning-for-image-proce: Chinese video course with PyTorch and TensorFlow code for classic vision networks, from LeNet and ResNet to YOLO, U-Net and Vision Transformer.
fastai/fastbook: The Jupyter notebooks behind the fastai deep learning book and course, teaching deep learning with fastai and PyTorch.
SYSTRAN/faster-whisper: Faster reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper speech-to-text using CTranslate2: up to 4x faster for the same accuracy, with less memory.
walkinglabs/learn-harness-engineering: Free project-based course on the files, state, checks and controls that make AI coding agents work reliably on real projects.
deepset-ai/haystack: Open-source Python framework from deepset for building production LLM apps: RAG pipelines, agents and search, with any model provider.
index-tts/index-tts: Zero-shot text-to-speech that speaks in a voice from one reference clip, with emotion control, in Chinese, English and more.
Cinnamon/kotaemon: Open-source, self-hosted web app for chatting with your documents, with hybrid search, citations and support for local or cloud models.
mozilla-ai/llamafile: Mozilla project that packs an open LLM into a single executable file you can download and run locally on most computers with no install.
pascalorg/editor: Open-source 3D building editor for architecture and construction that runs in the browser or locally, and lets AI agents edit models over MCP.
shap/shap: Python library that explains machine learning predictions with Shapley values, showing how much each feature pushed a prediction up or down.
browserbase/stagehand: SDK for browser agents from Browserbase: mix Playwright-style code with plain-English act, observe and extract steps that adapt when sites change.
earthtojake/text-to-cad: Plugin that lets AI coding agents design physical parts: they write CAD models in Python, check them for manufacturing and export STEP, STL or 3MF.
toon-format/toon: A compact, readable format for sending JSON data to LLMs with fewer tokens, plus a TypeScript library and CLI to convert both ways.
Anjok07/ultimatevocalremovergui: Desktop app that uses AI source separation models to remove or isolate vocals and instruments from songs, with installers for Windows and macOS.
lucidrains/vit-pytorch: Simple PyTorch implementations of the Vision Transformer and dozens of its variants, ready to drop into image models.
m-bain/whisperX: Fast Whisper speech-to-text with accurate word-level timestamps and optional speaker labels (who spoke when).
